content:
- Model consistently overestimates prices in early forecast periods, especially after recent spikes; reduce initial forecast values by 2–5%.
- After a sharp price spike, model tends to overshoot and then overcorrect; cap forecast peaks at 10–15% below true peak.
- Model underestimates mean-reverting periods; add 1–3% upward bias to forecast when recent 7-day average is below 30-day average.
- Forecast horizon 30d shows persistent lag in capturing true price momentum; shift forecast 1–2 days ahead for short-term spikes.
- Model exhibits strong bias toward higher prices in late forecast periods; apply downward correction of 3–7% for final 5–7 days of forecast.
- When true outcome shows sudden drop after spike, model fails to adjust; add 5–10% downward bias in subsequent 3–5 days.
